mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations face higher discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 4.2% and strong monthly employment growth above 150k persons indicates a tightening labor market that accelerates inflation expectations, triggering Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.2 and PAYEMS > 150.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts exceeding 1200k units and retail sales level above 490,000 million dollars signal economic overheating, prompting central bank intervention and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 490000.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4.2% indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 104.5 index points indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 104.5.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level exceeding 17200 billion dollars signals robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 17200.
